title: Projects, Project Management and the Five Integrated Elements

header.html: Key concepts relating to projects and PRINCE2 (3%)

Recall the integrated elements, the definition of a project and of project management, the aspects of project performance and the delivery approaches; describe why project management is used, the challenges PRINCE2 addresses, the characteristics of a project, projects in context and the features and benefits of PRINCE2
the official PRINCE2 7 Foundation syllabus (PeopleCert), learning outcome 1

toc.title: Why projects need management, and what PRINCE2 offers

html:
1What PRINCE2 is

PRINCE2 is a project management method: a structured, flexible way to plan, delegate, monitor and control a project. It can be tailored to any project, whatever its size, type or setting.

PRINCE2 has five integrated elements:

Element What it is
Principles Seven guiding obligations and good practices
People Leading, managing and involving everyone affected
Practices Seven areas that must be addressed throughout the project
Processes Seven stages of the project life, from start to close
Project context The environment the project lives in, which tailoring responds to

Old wording The 6th edition had principles, themes, processes and tailoring. In PRINCE2 7 the themes became practices, people was added, and tailoring sits inside project context.

Exam tip

. Principles, people, practices, processes, project context are the five integrated elements. If an option says themes, it is the old wording.

2Project and project management

Term Meaning
Project A temporary organization created to deliver one or more business products according to an agreed business case
Project management Planning, delegating, monitoring and controlling all aspects of the project, and motivating the people involved, to meet the project's objectives within the agreed performance targets

Characteristics of a project: change, temporary, cross-functional, unique, uncertain. [Verify live]

Aspects of project performance (managed throughout)

PRINCE2 7 lists seven aspects: benefits, risks, quality, scope, cost, time and sustainability. [Verify live] The 6th edition listed six; sustainability is the new one.

Exam tip

. A question that asks which aspect was added in PRINCE2 7 has one answer: sustainability.

3Why projects need management, and what PRINCE2 offers

Common challenges projects face: unclear objectives, changing requirements, scope creep, unrealistic plans, weak ownership, poor communication, late discovery of problems, and loss of the business reason for doing the work.

Features and benefits of PRINCE2 include: a focus on the business case, defined roles and responsibilities, control by stages and by exception, a product focus, proven and widely recognized good practice, and tailoring to suit the project.

4Delivery approaches and project context

Delivery approach Idea
Linear-sequential Work is done in order; each phase finishes before the next
Iterative-incremental Work is done in repeated cycles; the product is built up in increments
Hybrid A mix of the two

PRINCE2 works with any approach. The project context (organization, environment, programme or portfolio setting, delivery approach, culture) decides how the method is tailored.

Exam tip

. A project is temporary. Any option that calls a project a permanent organization is wrong.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Which list names the five integrated elements of PRINCE2 7?

  • APrinciples, themes, processes, tailoring, people
  • BPrinciples, people, practices, processes, project context
  • CPlans, risks, quality, issues, progress
  • DBusiness case, organizing, plans, quality, risk
Show the answer

Answer: B. Option A is mixed old wording; C and D are practices.

S2Which statements about a project are CORRECT? (1) A project is a temporary organization. (2) A project is created to deliver one or more business products. (3) A project is permanent. (4) A project has no business case.

  • A2 and 3
  • B3 and 4
  • C1 and 2
  • D1 and 4
Show the answer

Answer: C. A project is temporary and delivers business products.

S3Identify the missing word. Project management is the planning, delegating, monitoring and controlling of all aspects of the project to achieve its objectives within the agreed [ ? ].

  • ARoles
  • BPerformance targets
  • CProducts
  • DStages
Show the answer

Answer: B. The management is judged against the performance targets.

S4Which aspect of project performance was added in PRINCE2 7?

  • ASustainability
  • BTime
  • CQuality
  • DScope
Show the answer

Answer: A. Sustainability is the new aspect.

S5A team builds a product in repeated cycles, adding to it each time. Which delivery approach is this?

  • ALinear-sequential
  • BHybrid only
  • CWaterfall
  • DIterative-incremental
Show the answer

Answer: D. Repeated cycles that build in increments are iterative-incremental.

S6In PRINCE2 7, what are the old PRINCE2 themes now called?

  • APractices
  • BPrinciples
  • CProcesses
  • DElements
Show the answer

Answer: A. The themes became practices.

5.2 Recall questions

R1Define a project.

Show the answer

A temporary organization created to deliver one or more business products according to an agreed business case.

R2Name the five integrated elements.

Show the answer

Principles, people, practices, processes and project context.

R3Name the seven aspects of project performance.

Show the answer

Benefits, risks, quality, scope, cost, time and sustainability.

R4Name the three delivery approaches.

Show the answer

Linear-sequential, iterative-incremental and hybrid.

R5How many principles, practices and processes are there?

Show the answer

Seven of each.

R6What does tailoring respond to?

Show the answer

The project context.

6Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Elements principles, people, practices, processes, project context
Project temporary organization delivering business products for a business case
Aspects benefits, risks, quality, scope, cost, time, sustainability
Delivery linear-sequential, iterative-incremental, hybrid
Old wording themes
